zero_transmission_definition.purpose: Test whether one fixed angular stop implements one universal zero transmission across structural variants
zero_transmission_definition.conclusion: With known physical A0 the effective transmission is universal; defining zero as a nearest angular band introduces structural contamination

absolute_curve_errors.purpose: Separate D4C-to-finite-spectrum representation error from electromagnetic solver error
absolute_curve_errors.conclusion: Finite-spectrum controls have nonzero model residuals even before FDTD; no mark-specific DC correction is applied
